text: The tide has covered our street, the front room is filling and we are on the roof.
Our van is waiting; everyone has boarded and no one needs help.
Two people are stuck in the lift while smoke enters the stairwell.
Please send medicine for the woman who has run out of insulin.
There is enough drinking water here; we do not need more.
A chemical smell is coming from the broken pipe behind the school.
The bridge is still standing and cars can pass normally.
An older man fell and cannot stand after hurting his hip.
Please arrange somewhere safe for families to spend tonight.
The flames have been put out and responders say the area is safe.
The road has disappeared under a mudslide; no vehicles can get through.
We are hungry, have no food left, and need supplies for the children.
The lights and mobile network both went down after the storm.
Can someone take the injured residents to the clinic?
The family has blankets and a full tank of fuel; no supplies are required.
A tornado damaged several houses and people are calling out from inside.
There is no fire, but the road is blocked by a fallen tree.
We have no way to call the response team; the phone lines are down.
My child is having a seizure and needs urgent attention.
We can see floodwater on television but our home is dry and safe.
Strong wind has taken off the roof and rain is entering the bedrooms.
No evacuation is necessary; officials have cleared our neighborhood.
The generator needs fuel, and our batteries are almost empty.
A passenger is pinned inside the crashed car and cannot move.
The hospital has its own working generator and has not lost power.
Rocks and soil slid down the hillside and buried the entrance.
Please bring clean water and a working radio to our group.
There are armed men threatening people at the station.
My mother is out of her daily tablets and needs the prescription filled.
We have a shelter and are not asking to be moved.
A boat is visible downstream, but nobody is trapped or asking for rescue.
A wave from the storm has broken the sea wall and water is coming in.
There is no outbreak and the clinic is treating regular patients.
Can we get a wheelchair accessible vehicle to the medical center?
The electricity returned an hour ago, and the tower is working again.
A ceiling fell on a worker and an ambulance is urgently needed.
No one here lacks food, water, medicine or a place to sleep.
The local radio mast is on fire and we cannot contact anyone by phone.
We have petrol for three days but still need clean water to drink.
A bus is coming to collect us; we are safe and do not require transport.
The retaining wall failed and dirt is sliding over the access road.
Please find a safe route away from the fire before the wind changes.
We are not injured, have a charged phone and can leave on our own.
Our food is fine, but we have no drinking water since the pipe broke.
A person is unconscious and not responding to us.
No toxic leak has been found and there is no gas odor.
We need dry clothes, sleeping bags and a tent.
The creek is rising but the house is on high ground; nobody needs rescue.
There is a power outage and a patient needs oxygen connected to a working source.
A large crack appeared in the wall but the structure is still stable.
